bestiary.isekai_mahou.abyss_sovereign.de: Lord of the Abyss, seated on a throne of dead stars. It devours the light around it. Light is its weakness.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.adventurer.desc: Adventurers roaming the world in search of quests. They chat, fight by your side and sometimes trade items.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.angel_sentinel.des: A winged guard of the Crystal City. A spear of light, judgments from the sky and a divine shield when wounded.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.animal_spirit.desc: An ancestral animal spirit that answers the druids' call.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.arcane_golem.desc: A runic construct guarding ancient ruins. It ignores polite visitors; provoked, it lights its runes and fights.
An illusory copy of the Renegade Archmage, almost perfect: only sharp eyes notice the faint transparency. It fires weak missiles and shatters with a single blow — the hard part is finding out which one is real.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.arrancar.desc: A Hollow that tore off its own mask and gained a human form. Fast as a blink, proud as a king, with a name that demands respect.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.ascension_shadow.d: The Shadow of Tribulation: your own dark reflection, born from the Ascension Ritual. It knows the spells you prepared and only uses its ultimate when it is losing. To defeat it is to defeat yourself.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.basilisk.desc: Whoever stares at it for too long turns to stone. A pumpkin on your head protects from its gaze; sunlight weakens it.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.bone_warrior.desc: A warrior of bones who serves the necromancer with shield and sword.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.bramble_hound.desc: A hound of branches and thorns with firefly eyes. It sniffs out intruders at the Fey Court and never lets go.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.cherub.desc: A small support celestial: it does not attack, but heals angels and blinds attackers with a flash.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.corrupted_ent.desc: An ancestral tree poisoned by corruption. Its roots still remember what it was like to protect the forest.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.corrupted_witch.de: The elder witch who tasted her own curse. Her cauldron boils with plagues.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.creeping_shade.des: Almost invisible in the dark, it strikes with corrupting lunges and a veil of darkness. The sun dissolves it.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.crystal_golem.desc: A crystal guardian that reflects projectiles — even spells — back at the shooter. Pickaxes break it.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.crystal_mole.desc: Shy, with amethyst crystals on its back. When provoked it burrows away and pops up behind its target.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.cultist.desc: A hooded caster of Shadow, Fire or Arcane glyph spells. Interrupt the casting by striking before it finishes.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.desert_basilisk.de: King of the tombs beneath the dunes. Meeting its eyes means becoming a statue; it also swims through sand like a lake.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.dire_wolf.desc: A giant taiga wolf. Neutral, but tameable with meat — and, saddled, it becomes a mount with impressive leaps.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.ember_imp.desc: A flying imp that scratches with burning claws, flees laughing and fires bursts of embers.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.fairy.desc: A peaceful little creature of the flower fields that heals the wounded. Give it flowers and you may gain a friend for life.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.false_hydra.desc: It lives beneath abandoned villages and sings so nobody remembers it. Its heads only exist when nobody looks.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.familiar_cat.desc: A familiar cat, as mysterious as any cat. It senses danger before anyone else.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.familiar_crow.desc: A familiar crow bound to its master's soul. It sees far and brings news.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.fey_pixie.desc: A mischievous pixie of the eternal twilight. It laughs, steals, swaps things around and flees — and sometimes lands a spell that really hurts.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.fire_slime.desc: A slime that absorbed volcanic embers. It burns whatever it touches and leaves flames where it lands; water and rain make it hiss in pain.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.gargoyle.desc: A motionless statue while someone watches it. At night, unobserved, it wakes and hunts from the air. Earth magic breaks it.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.goblin.desc: Small, green and cowardly alone — dangerous in a pack. It steals whatever lies on the ground and flees when things get rough.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.goblin_archer.desc: A goblin who learned that arrows hurt more from afar. It keeps its distance and backs away if you close in.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.goblin_king.desc: Lord of the goblin fortress. A huge axe, crushing leaps and a horn that brings the whole kingdom into battle.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.goblin_shaman.desc: Casts real glyph spells and heals its pack. Take the shaman down first and the rest falls apart.
A goblin riding a huge wolf: fast, it pounces on prey and strikes with bite and spear at once.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.greater_air_elemen: A living tornado that slices with wind blades and lifts enemies in a cyclone. The fall hurts.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.greater_earth_elem: A colossus of stone, moss and crystal. Its earthquakes root anyone on the ground and it heals while touching the earth.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.greater_fire_eleme: A magma torso above a vortex of flames. Burning punches, magma balls and a fire nova when surrounded.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.greater_water_elem: A body of living water, always soaked — which makes Lightning devastating against it. It pulls everyone in with whirlpools.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.griffin.desc: Half eagle, half lion, pride of the skies. To win a griffin's trust is to win the sky.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.guild_master.desc: The Guild Master, veteran of a thousand battles. He is the one who runs the rank promotion trials.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.guild_receptionist: The Adventurers' Guild receptionist: registers newcomers, hands out quests and never loses her smile.
The Spectral Stranger appears at high noon for anyone carrying a mana revolver. It only accepts a clean duel: whoever draws before the bell loses.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.harpy.desc: It circles its prey high in the mountains and dives with its talons. Its shrill scream slows everyone nearby.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.hex_cat.desc: A cursed black cat summoned by the Corrupted Witch. It pounces on its target without warning and vanishes in a puff of smoke soon after. No one has ever tamed one.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.hobgoblin.desc: The pack's sergeant: bigger, armored and shielded. It blocks blows from the front — axes break its guard.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.hollow_brute.desc: A Hollow the size of a cart, all arms and hunger. Its mask withstands blows that would shatter a shield.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.hollow_crawler.des: A low six-legged Hollow with a cracked bone mask. It hunts in packs and vanishes into the white sand between lunges.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.hollow_king.desc: Barragan Louisenbairn, the King of Hueco Mundo, on the throne of the Gate of Las Noches. In his Resurrección (Arrogante) he becomes the crowned king of bones: everything he touches ages and crumbles. He returns to the throne a day after being defeated.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.hollow_wraith.desc: A winged Hollow that dives from the moonless sky. They say its shriek echoes the last word it spoke in life.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.ignis.desc: Fire Guardian of the Ember Isles. Meteor showers, lava pools and waves of flame. It hates water.
A demonic patron chained to an unholy altar. The chains will not hold it forever.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.king_slime.desc: The gelatinous monarch. It leaps to crush foes with a sticky shockwave and, with every serious wound, splits into smaller subjects.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.kobold.desc: A small reptilian miner of the caves. It digs ores, keeps everything in a pouch and calls its kin when attacked.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.lesser_phoenix.des: A bird of fire that is reborn once from its own ashes, bursting into flames. Defeat it twice.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.lich.desc: A necromancer who defeated death and forgot how to live. Its phylactery holds the secret of its immortality.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.living_shadow.desc: The caster's own shadow, torn loose by Shadow magic to fight on its own.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.lizardman.desc: A swamp warrior with a long-reaching spear. It swims very well and breathes underwater.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.lumen_sprite.desc: A peaceful light spirit that only appears by day. Fed glowstone dust, it repays with an essence.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.manticore.desc: A lion with bat wings and a tail that fires fans of spikes. Its roar freezes courage.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.menos_giant.desc: A black-robed giant with a long nose and a white mask, tall as a tower. It charges a beam in its mouth that erases whole dunes.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.mimic.desc: A perfect chest... too perfect. Its lid turns into a toothy maw when you get close.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.mimic_king.desc: The chest of chests. It turns its own vault into a trap, swallows adventurers and spits out what it dislikes.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.minotaur.desc: Guardian of the labyrinth. Stunning charges and a sweeping double axe — if it slams into a wall, that is your chance.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.moss_golem.desc: A slow guardian of lush caves. It regenerates in light and rain and roots in place whoever provokes it.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.ogre.desc: Huge and slow. It raises its club with both hands before smashing the ground — when you see the warning, get out of the way.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.orc.desc: A strong warrior with a heavy cleaver; it roams in hordes and attacks players, villagers and golems alike.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.orc_berserker.desc: When badly hurt it goes berserk: roars, vents red steam and becomes much faster and stronger. End the fight quickly.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.orc_lord.desc: Leader of the orc camp. Its ground slams send out shockwaves and its war cry empowers the whole horde.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.patron_drowned_kin: The Drowned King, patron of the depths. Its rusted crown still commands the tides.
Patron of infernal flames. It demands burning offerings from those who seal pacts with it.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.patron_void_lady.d: Patron of the Void, whose whispers promise forbidden knowledge in exchange for pieces of the soul.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.pegasus.desc: A winged horse of the Celestial Sanctuary. They say it only accepts riders with a sincere heart.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.poison_jelly.desc: A purple, venomous jelly of the swamps. Do not touch, do not step on, do not taste.
The dragon that was every element before the elements had names. Sealed beyond the Twilight by the six sages, it woke when the Herald fell. Five phases: Fire, Water, Earth, Wind and the Twilight itself.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.primordial_golem.d: Earth Guardian of the Earthen Peaks. It hurls boulders where you are going to be and makes the ground quake.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.quincy_npc.desc: Archers in white with blue crosses who live in camps. They fight with bows of light and, once surrendered, may hand over their power through the Auswählen.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.ranger_eagle.desc: The Ranger's scout eagle. From above, it marks targets for the whole pack.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.ranger_steed.desc: The Ranger's steed: it answers the call, endures long trails and lets its rider shoot at full gallop.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.ranger_wolf.desc: The Ranger's wolf: loyal, fast and always first to reach the prey. It grows alongside its master.
An archmage who traded ethics for power. It knows spells no grimoire dares to record.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.ruin_colossus.desc: A golem the size of a tower, built to protect a city that no longer exists. Every punch opens a crater.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.salamander.desc: A fire lizard of deserts and the Nether. It spits fireballs and bites with flame; it hates water and rain.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.sand_empress.desc: Sovereign of the white desert. The sand obeys her as the tide obeys the moon: she sinks, resurfaces and turns every grain into a blade.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.seraph.desc: The six-winged Seraph who guards the Celestial Sanctuary. Shadow wounds what Light protects.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.sky_ray.desc: A giant ray that glides between the islands of the Elemental Plane as if the sky were an ocean.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.slime.desc: A blob of blue jelly, curious and harmless — until it takes the first hit. Many summoned heroes swear their first friend in this world was a slime.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.solar_sentinel.des: A golden construct that charges blinding sunbeams. At night it sleeps beneath the sand.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.steelball_mentor.d: Master Rotari, the wanderer in the wide hat. He teaches the Spin in five lessons — and only when the student is ready.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.stone_slime.desc: A slime full of pebbles: it shrugs off half of physical damage and shoves with surprising strength.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.storm_hawk.desc: A peak predator that calls lightning: a ring of sparks marks the ground seconds before the strike.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.storm_wyvern.desc: A flying storm drake. Immune to lightning — it heals it — and stronger during storms.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.summoned_demon.des: A demon summoned from the depths to fight for its caller — for as long as the pact lasts.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.summoned_ent.desc: An ent summoned by Nature magic. Ancient, patient and very, very strong.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.summoned_guardian_: A guardian fairy summoned by Light magic to protect its caster.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.summoned_imp.desc: An imp summoned through a pact. Small, annoying and surprisingly useful in battle.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.summoned_salamande: A salamander summoned by Fire magic to fight alongside its caster.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.summoned_stone_gol: A stone golem raised by Earth magic. Slow, but a living wall.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.summoned_sylph.des: A sylph summoned by Wind magic, fast as a gust.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.summoned_undine.de: An undine summoned by Water magic, protecting and healing its caster.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.swamp_hydra.desc: Every severed head becomes two — unless the stump burns. Its poison builds up in whoever stays too close.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.sylph.desc: A playful wind spirit. Sometimes it dances around travelers and blesses them with speed.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.thorn_queen.desc: The Thorn Queen rules the Fey Court with a smile and a thousand thorns that dance to the sound of her laughter.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.tide_guardian.desc: Tide, Water Guardian of the Suspended Sea. Whirlpools, tsunamis and patience as deep as the ocean.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.tide_serpent.desc: Hunter of the oceans: it chases swimmers and sailors, bites to drag them down and knocks people off boats.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.trial_avatar.desc: Elemental Avatar: the warden of the Trial Chambers, a body of plates floating around a crystal core. It takes the color and spells of the element being tested — programmed spells included — and grows deadlier with each phase. Every big attack is marked on the ground before it lands.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.trial_sentinel.des: Trial Sentinel: a shield-bearing elite that guards the Avatar in the highest trials. It charges in a straight line and strikes in an area — stay out of the marks on the ground.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.troll.desc: Regenerates frighteningly fast... unless it is burning. Fire deals double damage and stops the regeneration.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.twilight_herald.de: The Twilight Herald, cause of the Great Rupture. It expands its own Domain and blends Light and Shadow into something impossible.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.undead_servant.des: An undead servant raised by a necromancer. Loyal, tireless and without opinions of its own.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.undine.desc: A water spirit of rivers and seas. Neutral, but it defends its sisters with water jets and healing songs.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.void_bat.desc: A hunter of the deep caves that drains life and blinks away when wounded.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.void_crawler.desc: A shadow arthropod that climbs walls and reappears behind its prey.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.wandering_mage.des: A traveling magic merchant: sells Glyph Scrolls, crystals and essences. It defends itself well and leaves after a while.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.wandering_spirit.d: An arcane soul with a violet lantern. Those who stay peacefully by its side receive a gift before it fades.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.watcher_eye.desc: A floating eye with tentacles. It charges a shadow beam — break line of sight before it fires.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.water_slime.desc: Translucent jelly that soaks whoever it touches and regenerates in water. Water magic only makes it stronger.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.werewolf.desc: Appears only on full-moon nights. Very fast, it howls to call the local wolves and vanishes at dawn.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.wind_slime.desc: Light as a bubble, it leaps high and far, carried by air currents only it can feel.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.wyvern.desc: A lesser dragon of the Abyss. Wild, territorial and swift — a fearsome mount for whoever tames it.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.wyvern_king.desc: Lord of the peak storms. It dives from the sky, spits lightning and prefers wet prey.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.young_kraken.desc: An amphibious cephalopod that grabs and crushes. A strong blow makes it let go of its prey.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.zanpakuto_spirit.d: The Zanpakutō's spirit, who lives in the Shinigami's Inner World. It talks, tests and sometimes fights: the other half of the sword's soul.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.zephyr.desc: Zephyr, Wind Guardian of the Storm Skies. Fast as a thought, it summons tornadoes and air blades.

journal.isekai_mahou.awakening.awaken_el: Your class's affinity element awakens when you choose it. A spell's element comes from its glyphs: add a Fire effect and it is a Fire spell. If nothing awakened, look for an Elemental Shrine.
Fire, Water, Earth, Wind, Light and Shadow sleep within the world, waiting for someone worthy. The first element to awaken usually says a lot about who you are.
journal.isekai_mahou.awakening.build_spe: In the Grimoire, combine a Form (like Projectile or Touch) with an Effect (like Arcane Damage or Push), name it and save it in a free slot (C) or in the Library. The ready spells in Z and X are good examples.
Techniques are glyphs too. In the Grimoire, combine a Form from your class (bullet, card, steel ball, arrow...) with an Effect, like Push or Arcane Damage, and save it in a free slot (C).

Techniques are glyphs too. In the Grimoire, combine a Form from your class (or Strike: your next hit carries the effects) with an Effect and save it in a free slot (C). Everything combines with your elements.
Nobody here is born knowing ready-made spells: magic is written with glyphs. A Form says how the spell leaves you; Effects say what it does; Augments change how. The rest is creativity.
journal.isekai_mahou.awakening.choose_pa: The class choice appears when you join the world. If you closed it without choosing, leave and rejoin to see it.

Magic, Physical or Dexterity: fifteen classes, each with its own resource (Mana, Vigor or Focus) and its own system — the Forge, Theft, the Zanpakutō, Luck... Your class decides how you fight, how you grow and which elements understand your soul.
journal.isekai_mahou.awakening.first_rit: Your class's first rank
Each class has its own ritual — see the Class Route at the top of the Journal (B → Journal).
Plant the Ancestral Sapling from your kit, make the offering and finish the season task until it grows.
Enchant yourself and allies, nullify spells and use the Codex on an enchanting table for Inscription I.
Roll the dice, land cards and win the House Round in the House Table tab (B): Bronze Chip.
Land 60 shots, reload 15 times (F) and claim rank I in the Trigger Path tab (B).
Place the Oath Altar from your kit, engrave spells on the Runic Blade and swear Oath I at the altar.
Place the Research Table from your kit, pick a thesis and complete its task to defend it.
Place the Ossuary Altar from your kit and offer it the souls you reap from enemies.
Absorb projectiles, defeat enemies with the Spirit Bow and reach rank I in the Quincy tab (B).
Call the pack, take enemies down with arrows and claim rank I in the Ranger's Trail tab (B).
Steal with Light Hand, strike from behind and use the Ledger from your kit to reach rank I (Cutpurse).
Meditate with the Zanpakutō (crouch still), use Kidō and reach rank I in the Shinigami tab (B).
Place the Arcane Anvil from your kit, forge and reshape a blade and bring 8 iron to the anvil: Forge Trial I.
Hit 30 times with the steel ball and talk to Master Rotari (the kit's Letter calls him): 1st lesson.
Draw the circle with ritual chalk around the Offering Altar and seal your first pact.
Place the Cauldron from your kit over a fire, follow a recipe from the book and brew the ritual potion.

Each class grows its own way: theses, recipes, pacts, trees and souls; the Forge, the Ledger, the Oaths, the Inscription, the Zanpakutō, the Auswählen, the Trigger, the Trail, the House Chips and the Spin. The Class Route in the Journal guides it all.

journal.isekai_mahou.awakening.first_spe: Hold Z, X or C to use what is in that slot (some spells take a moment to cast). G is the ultimate slot.

Hold Z, X or C to use the technique in that slot — each class has its own (the Gunslinger shoots, the Gambler throws cards, Steel Ball spins...). Techniques spend Focus, which comes back with every hit.
Hold Z, X or C to cast the spell in that slot (some take a moment to cast). It spends Mana. G is the ultimate slot.
Hold Z, X or C to use the technique in that slot — each class has its own ready (the Smith hammers, the Rogue steals, the Shinigami cuts...). Techniques spend Vigor, which comes back with every hit.
The first casting is always clumsy: mana slips through your fingers, the light trembles. But it comes out. And that changes everything.
journal.isekai_mahou.awakening.intro: Welcome to this world! First, the basics: spells, an element and a few slimes. I'll stay close.
journal.isekai_mahou.awakening.lore: You open your eyes beneath a sky you do not know. Two pale moons fade into the dawn and the air hums with something your old world never had: mana. A gentle voice whispers that you were summoned for a reason — but before saving anything, you must survive. Choose your origin, learn to write spells with glyphs in the Grimoire and prove your strength against this world's simplest creatures.
journal.isekai_mahou.awakening.open_grim: Press B to open the Status Window and click the Grimoire tab. You can also switch tabs with the mouse wheel over the tab bar.
The Status Window shows everything you are: level, Circle, paths, spells. The Grimoire is its heart — the notebook where every spell is written, glyph by glyph.
journal.isekai_mahou.awakening.outro: Mana now runs through your veins like a second blood. In the taverns, people speak of an Adventurers' Guild that pays well for honest work — and of Trial Chambers where the elements test those who dare to claim them. The Guide Spirit smiles: "The true path begins now."
journal.isekai_mahou.awakening.slime_hun: Slimes live in plains, forests and swamps (water slimes near rivers; wind slimes in the mountains). Spell kills give more XP.
Every summoned hero starts like this: a wooden sword, a trembling spell and a blue jelly giving you a funny look.

journal.isekai_mahou.beyond_limit.abyss_: Clear an Abyss floor
Menu (B) → Abyss tab → Enter (level 100 or higher). Each floor has waves of enemies, stronger every time. Falling doesn't kill: you return to where you were, with no item loss.
The first step down. The air turns cold; the mana, thick.
B menu → Abyss tab
Reach floor 10
Every 10 new floors the Abyss hands over an Abyss Core, a rare prize and a new starting point: your next descent begins there.
The first milestone. Those who reach it no longer start from zero.
Milestone: Abyss Core
Reach floor 100
This world's greatest challenge. The Abyss Ranking (Abyss tab and Renown Board) shows who went deepest.
No one has gone this deep. If anything waits at the bottom, it already knows your name.
The greatest challenge
Reach floor 25
Each floor makes enemies stronger (+10% health, +4% damage). Bring a party: a level 100+ mate can join in the pause between floors (up to 4). Abyss Cores refill mana and ultimates.
Down here common monsters already hit like the bosses up there.
Bring a party
Reach floor 50
No shortcut: high level, level 100+ spells, gear with gems and runes, and a tight party. Always start from your last 10-floor milestone.
Halfway to nowhere. The Abyss has no bottom — but it has respect.
High level and a party
Defeat a Shadow
Every 5th floor brings the Shadow of a boss you have already beaten. In the Abyss tab, under Shadow Fights, you can challenge a single one. Shadows pay Shadow Fragments.
It is your own past coming back to collect — stronger, darker and without mercy.
Floor 5 or the Abyss tab
Defeat 10 Shadows
Shadows on boss floors and Shadow Fights from the Abyss tab both count. The first win against each boss pays an Abyss Core.
Ten rematches. Ten times the past lost again.
Shadow Fights
journal.isekai_mahou.beyond_limit.intro: You still feel the Dragon's ember, don't you? The story is over, but the Endless Abyss has no bottom. Open the Menu, Abyss tab: endless floors and the Shadows of the bosses you have beaten. Let's see how deep you go.
journal.isekai_mahou.beyond_limit.level_: After the Dragon, the Tenth Circle's ceiling becomes 200 and the XP banked at 150 comes back. Every level above 100 raises your Mana Limit, glyphs per spell and Power.
The first step above the impossible. The air grows lighter; the mana, denser.
The deep floors of the Abyss, the Shadows and returning bosses give a lot of XP. Train your resource every day: the Limit rises with it.
The bards stop singing when you walk into the tavern. They no longer know which rhymes to use.
The absolute maximum. Everything after this is yours: cities to rule, factions, friends to teach and spells no one has imagined yet.
The last step. There is no sign, no door. Only you and the silence of one who has arrived.
journal.isekai_mahou.beyond_limit.lore: The story is over: the Dragon sleeps and your legend is written. But the ember of its heart has not cooled — it beats in your chest and pulls downward. Beneath the world lies a pit no one has measured: the Endless Abyss. There is no plot down there, only floors, each deeper and stronger than the last, and the Shadows of everything you have beaten waiting for a rematch. From here on there is no next chapter. Only how deep you can stand to go.
journal.isekai_mahou.beyond_limit.outro: Floor 50. Down there the silence has weight, and the Shadows no longer feel like enemies: they feel like old acquaintances. The Abyss keeps going down — it always does. But now, when anyone in this world asks how far one can go, it is your name they will say.
journal.isekai_mahou.beyond_limit.title: The Endless Abyss
journal.isekai_mahou.class_druid.ent.hin: Defeat the Corrupted Ent at the Druid Circle (the arrow points there). The forest thanks you with a new Ancestral Sapling.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_druid.ent.lor: At the Druid Circle, an ancient tree rotted from within.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_druid.intro: Druid! Plant the Ancestral Sapling from your kit, make the offerings and finish the season tasks. The tree grows, and so do you.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_druid.kit.hin: Plant the Ancestral Sapling from your kit in an open spot (it will grow A LOT). Click it to see the offering and the stage task.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_druid.kit.lor: A single leaf, but glowing like an emerald.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_druid.lore: The Druid plants their own magic. The Ancestral Sapling grows with offerings and with care for the forest — and every stage of the tree is a rank, an animal spirit and a piece of the world's heart that starts beating in your chest.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_druid.outro: The Heart Tree is complete. The forest's animals stop as you pass, just to watch you.
Ritual rank I: make the offering and finish the season task until the sapling grows.
Ritual rank II: the tree asks for new offerings and forest tasks.
Ritual rank III: the middle stage asks for a Circle and bigger offerings.
Ritual rank IV: the tree's core asks for essences and rare deeds.
Ritual rank V: the last stage completes the Heart Tree. Origin glyphs are yours: other classes only learn them from a Lesson you write.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_druid.title: The Ancestral Tree
journal.isekai_mahou.class_druid.trees.h: Plant saplings (of any tree) around the world: the Ancestral Sapling feels each one. Some season tasks ask for it.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_druid.trees.l: Whoever plants a forest never walks alone.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_enchanter.all: Form a party (crouch + scroll on a player → Invite) and use enchantments on them — Enchantment Link spreads them to the party. For rank II: 80 enchantments, 60 magic nullified and 50 kills.
An Enchanter alone is strong. An Enchanter with a party is an army.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_enchanter.ant: Keep Anti-Magic active and face casters (witches, mages, bosses): it cancels much of the damage and effects of enemy spells — but also holds back your own offensive spells.
The fireball hits your chest and turns to smoke. The enemy mage stares at their own hands in confusion.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_enchanter.app: Use Might, Haste and the other enchantments (Enchanter glyphs in your slots) on yourself or an ally. They stack up to a limit. For rank I: level 5, 25 applied and 15 kills while enchanted.
One touch, a rune on the skin, and the body remembers it can do more.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_enchanter.hea: Activate Heavenly Restriction and fight in melee only: while it lasts you cannot cast, but you are immune to sure-hits that target mana. For rank IV: 400 enchantments, 900 nullified, 25 on allies and 2 bosses.
No spell, no mana. Just the body — and it is enough.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_enchanter.int: Enchanter! The Codex from your kit and an enchanting table are your altar: enchant yourself and allies, nullify spells with Anti-Magic and engrave the five ranks of the Inscription.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_enchanter.lor: Might, haste, aegis, vitality: the Enchanter writes power onto themselves and their allies like writing in a book. And keeps two forbidden pages — Anti-Magic, which makes spells die on the skin, and Heavenly Restriction, which trades all mana for a body no magic can see.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_enchanter.out: The Sovereign of Enchantments never needs to raise their voice: allies grow stronger just by standing near, and enemies weaker just by remembering the name.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_enchanter.ove: Use Overdrive on yourself or an ally in real fights. For rank III: 200 enchantments, 300 magic nullified, 100 kills and 1 boss. The reward is Heavenly Restriction.
For a few seconds everything doubles — and then the body sends the bill.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_enchanter.ran: Circle 1, level 5, 25 enchantments and 15 enchanted kills. Stand by an enchanting table with 12 lapis and 4 amethyst and use the Codex on it (5 s rite). You learn Aegis, Vitality and Enchantment Link.
Inscriber: the first rune etches into your arm.
Circle 2, level 15, 80 enchantments, 8 on allies, 60 magic nullified and 50 kills. Offering: 24 lapis, 2 Light and 2 Wind Essences. You learn Imbue Weapon, Overdrive and awaken Wind.

Circle 4, level 25, the rank tasks and 1 boss. Offering: 32 lapis, 4 Mana Crystals and 1 diamond. You learn Heavenly Restriction (no mana, absurd body, invisible to magic detection) and the Emperor's Fist legend.
Circle 6, level 45, the rank tasks and 2 bosses. Offering: 2 diamonds, 8 Mana Crystals, 4 Light and 4 Wind Essences. You learn Enchanted Gear and the Celestial Body legend.
Celestial Body: your gear learns to be enchanted too.

Circle 8, level 75, 800 enchantments, 2500 nullified, 100 Restriction kills and 4 bosses. Offering: 3 diamonds, 16 crystals and 6 Arcane, Light and Wind essences. You learn the G form Sovereign's Sanctum and a legend.
Sovereign of Enchantments: the Sovereign's Sanctum opens.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_gambler.cards: Throw charged cards (Playing Card and the Card form) at enemies. For the Bronze Chip: level 5, 40 rolls, 25 cards and the House Round (6 kills in 60 s, 1-chip stake).
An energy-charged card cuts the air and bursts on the target. Ace of spades, preferably.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_gambler.casin: Use the Domain Casino of Fortune in big fights. For the Platinum Chip: level 55, Circle 6, 1000 rolls, 14 jackpots, 3 Casinos, 2 bosses and the Round (20 kills in 90 s, 7 chips).
Green felt, golden lights, and every enemy inside plays by YOUR rules.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_gambler.intro: Gambler! Every spell of yours rolls the dice. Throw cards, roll dice, gather Casino Chips and win the House Round in the House Table tab to climb the chips.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_gambler.jackp: The JACKPOT comes from very high rolls (Tension helps): infinite luck for a few seconds, with power and regen maxed. For the Silver Chip: 200 rolls, 2 jackpots and 20 big wins.
Three sevens. Bells, lights, a rain of coins — and for a few seconds you simply cannot miss.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_gambler.lore: Every Gambler spell rolls the dice: from −99% to +100% power, and everything in between. Bad luck exists — but Tension rises with every poor roll, and when the JACKPOT comes, luck turns infinite for a few seconds. Cards, dice, roulette, slot machine and, at the end, a whole Casino as a domain. The House always wins... unless you are the House.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_gambler.lucky: Kills with spells that rolled good luck. For the Gold Chip: level 35, Circle 4, 500 rolls, 6 jackpots, 40 lucky kills, 1 boss and the Round (15 kills in 90 s, 4 chips).
Sometimes luck doesn't help: it kills.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_gambler.outro: The diamond chip spins on your finger. At tables across every kingdom, nobody will bet against you.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_gambler.rank_: Level 5, Circle 1, 40 rolls and 25 cards. In the House Table tab (B), bet 1 Casino Chip and win the Round: 6 kills in 60 s (winning pays back double). You learn Dice and Double Down.
Bronze Chip: the House notices you.
Level 15, Circle 2, 200 rolls, 2 jackpots and 20 big wins; Round: 10 kills in 75 s, 2 chips. You learn Roulette, Loaded Dice and get the Deck II.
Silver Chip: the roulette spins for you.
Level 35, Circle 4, the chip tasks and 1 boss. You learn Slot Machine, Royal Flush and the Domain: Casino of Fortune — build it in the G slot.
Gold Chip: the Casino opens its doors.
Level 55, Circle 6, the chip tasks and 2 bosses. You learn the On Jackpot trigger (spells that fire when luck explodes) and get the Deck III.

Level 75, Circle 8, 2000 rolls, 30 jackpots and 4 bosses; Round: 30 kills in 120 s, 12 chips. You get the Deck IV and both Gambler Legends. Origin glyphs are yours: other classes only learn them from a Lesson you write.
Diamond Chip: you are the House.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_gambler.rolls: Every spell or technique you use rolls luck (the number shows on screen). Bad rolls fill Tension, which improves the next ones. Use any spell — the cards in your kit count too.
−99%? +100%? Your heart races with every cast. That's what you love.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_gambler.title: House Chips
journal.isekai_mahou.class_gunslinger.du: Between 10:00 and 14:00 in-game, under open sky in the Overworld, request the duel in the Trigger tab: the Spectral Stranger appears. Wait for DRAW! — firing early is a foul. Hitting right after = Perfect Draw.
3... 2... 1... DRAW! Whoever fires before the signal loses their honor. Whoever fires after loses their life.
After rank IV, request the tier II duel at noon: the Reaper draws faster. For rank V: 700 kills, 100 long kills and 4 bosses.
The second duel has no stranger: only Death in a hat, waiting for the bell.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_gunslinger.hi: Fire the Mana Revolver (use button) or the Bullet form in your slots. Bullets carry the effects you build in the Grimoire.
The first shot goes wide. The sixtieth hits a goblin's eye at thirty paces.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_gunslinger.in: Gunslinger! The Mana Revolver in your kit is only the start. Hit, reload (F) and climb the Trigger Path: each rank unlocks a new gun. At noon, beware the Stranger.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_gunslinger.lo: Bullet kills from 28 blocks or more. For rank IV also: 500 kills, 200 headshots and 2 bosses. The Rifle (rank IV) was made for this.
A dot on the horizon, a crack, and the dot falls.

Your mana does not leave as bolts or flames: it leaves through the barrel. Revolver, pistol, shotgun, dual pistols, rifle — every gun is made of mana, and every bullet carries the spell you build. The Trigger Path has five ranks, and two of them end in a duel at high noon.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_gunslinger.ou: Twelve tolls. The bell rings, the wind stops, and only one revolver clears its holster in time. Yours.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_gunslinger.ra: Level 8, Circle 1, 60 hits and 15 reloads. Claim it in the Trigger Path tab (B). You learn Burst, On Reload and get the Pistol.
The pistol is born in your hand.
Level 20, Circle 2, 20 headshots and 80 bullet kills. You learn Charged Shot, Incendiary Round and get the Shotgun.
Level 35, Circle 4, the High Noon Duel, 60 headshots and 10 long kills (28+ blocks). You learn Ricochet, Explosive Round, get the Dual Pistols and a Legend.
Dual pistols and a legend in your pocket.
Level 50, Circle 6, 500 kills, 200 headshots, 40 long kills and 2 bosses. You learn Piercing Round, Fan the Hammer and get the Rifle.
The rifle and Fan the Hammer.

Level 70, Circle 8, the Reaper defeated, 700 kills, 100 long kills and 4 bosses. You learn the G form Twelve Tolls and the second Legend. Origin glyphs are yours: other classes only learn them from a Lesson you write.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_gunslinger.re: Press F to reload the cylinder (spends Focus). The On Reload trigger casts spells as you reload. For rank I: level 8, Circle 1, 60 hits and 15 reloads.
Six shots, a spin of the cylinder, and again. Rhythm is half of aim.
Place the Oath Altar from your kit somewhere you will visit often (Oaths and legendary swords are made there). Click it to see what is missing.
White stone, golden runes and a sword-shaped socket: the altar awaits your word.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_knight.calibu: Defeat a boss while holding your blade and return to the Oath Altar: click it with the offering to awaken Caliburn. The other swords ask for the element guardian's core and kills with that element's spells.
The sword in the stone only comes out for one who has beaten a boss blade in hand.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_knight.engrav: Cast Engrave on Sword with a built spell: every hit of the Runic Blade releases the next rune (a runic strike). For Oath I: 25 runic strikes and 15 sword kills.
A whole spell inside the sword: the blow lands, the rune glows, the spell bursts.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_knight.four_s: For each elemental sword: the element guardian's core (Elemental Plane) and kills with its spells; some need the altar in the right place (storm, ice, night). Oath V asks for 3. The altar tells you what is missing.
Crimson, Storm, Eternal Frost, Darkness: each one asks for a deed of its element.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_knight.intro: Runic Knight! Place the Oath Altar from your kit, engrave spells on your blade and swear the five Oaths. The legendary swords are born at that altar too.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_knight.lake.h: With Caliburn awakened, surround the Oath Altar with water and click it with the offering. The Sword of the Lake empowers your G form Excalibur.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_knight.lake.l: Caliburn breaks on the altar surrounded by water, and the Lady of the Lake returns the true blade.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_knight.lore: A runic blade holds spells the way a sheath holds steel: engrave a spell on it and every swing releases a rune. Five Oaths at the Altar turn a squire into a Knight King — and six legendary swords await whoever earns them, from Caliburn's stone to the lake where the true one sleeps.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_knight.outro: The Runic Crown weighs less than you expected. Perhaps because six blades carry it with you.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_knight.rank_1: Circle 1, 25 runic strikes and 15 sword kills. Altar offering: 8 iron and 2 Light Essences. You learn Blade Aura and Runic Thrust. Progress is in the Oaths tab (B).
Runic Squire: the blade learns to hold magic.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_knight.rank_2: Circle 2, 150 runic strikes and 80 sword kills. Offering: 6 gold, 4 Light and 4 Earth Essences. You learn Runic Aegis, Sword Rain and get the Runic Blade II.
Engraved Knight: the altar stone begins to give.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_knight.rank_3: Circle 4, 400 runic strikes, 200 sword kills, 1 boss and 1 legendary sword. Offering: 4 diamonds and 6 Mana Crystals. You learn the G form Excalibur and get the Runic Blade III.
Knight of the Table: EXCALIBUR awakens as a G form.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_knight.rank_4: Circle 6, 700 runic strikes, 450 kills, 2 bosses and 2 legendary swords. Offering: 1 netherite, 8 Light and 8 Earth Essences. You learn Oath's Sentence, +1 rune slot and get the Blade IV.
Rune Paladin: the Oath's Sentence falls from the sky.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_knight.rank_5: Circle 8, 1200 runic strikes, 800 kills, 4 bosses and 3 legendary swords. Offering: 1 Nether Star and 16 Mana Crystals. You earn the Runic Crown (+15% techniques, +armor). Origin glyphs are yours: other classes only learn them from a Lesson you write.
Runic Knight King: the Runic Crown is yours.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_knight.title: The Oaths
journal.isekai_mahou.class_mage.glyphs.h: Glyph Scrolls (each costs 1 essence of the glyph's element), theses and Journal rewards. Other classes' glyphs only via Lesson.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_mage.glyphs.l: A mage is measured by the size of their vocabulary.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_mage.intro: Mage! The Research Table in your kit is your laboratory: pick a thesis, complete its task and defend it. Each rank brings new glyphs.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_mage.kit.hint: Place the Research Table from your kit. Click it to see the available theses, what each one asks for and what it awakens.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_mage.kit.lore: Scrolls, lenses and a quill that writes by itself when mana stirs.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_mage.lore: A Mage neither prays nor bargains: they study. At the Research Table, every thesis is a mana problem — circuits, runes, notes — and every thesis defended becomes a new glyph and a wider Circle of understanding.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_mage.master.h: Raise an element along its path (Paths tab) to the Master node. That element's spells and kills give it XP; Trials unlock the higher nodes.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_mage.master.l: Mastering an element means hearing its voice before you call it.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_mage.outro: The panel rises and applauds. No living mage has defended as many theses as you.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_mage.rank_1.h: Ritual rank I: at the Research Table, pick a thesis and complete the requested task (rune circuit, notes, materials). Defending the thesis records the rank and teaches glyphs.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_mage.rank_2.h: Ritual rank II: the Table shows the next theses; some ask for a Circle, essences or research notes. More theses, more glyphs.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_mage.rank_2.l: The academy starts quoting your name.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_mage.rank_3.h: Ritual rank III: harder theses ask for bigger circuits and awakened elements. Earn high-tier glyphs.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_mage.rank_4.h: Ritual rank IV: advanced theses cross elements and ask for rare boss materials.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_mage.rank_5.h: Ritual rank V: the last thesis brings together everything you learned. Origin glyphs are yours: other classes only learn them from a Lesson you write.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_mage.title: The Theses
journal.isekai_mahou.class_necromancer.i: Necromancer! Place the Ossuary Altar from your kit, reap souls from enemies and, at midnight, perform the Rite. Each rite is a rank.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_necromancer.k: Place the Ossuary Altar from your kit. Enemies defeated nearby (or with the scythe) leave souls that you offer at the altar.
Skulls, black candles and a chill that doesn't come from the wind.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_necromancer.l: Defeat the Lich in the Forgotten Crypt (the arrow points there). Its Phylactery is worth a lot for rites.
In the Forgotten Crypt, a necromancer who didn't know when to stop.

The Necromancer reaps what others leave behind. Souls caught on the scythe, bones on the altar, and at midnight the Ossuary Rite: every rite fulfilled is a rank, and every rank one more servant awaiting your orders.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_necromancer.o: The dead do not rest when you pass — they rise and bow.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_necromancer.r: Ritual rank I: with the requested souls, skulls on the altar and at midnight, begin the Ossuary Rite. Clicking the altar shows the ✔/✘ list.
Ritual rank II: new rites ask for more souls from different creatures.
Ritual rank III: middle rites ask for a Circle and rare souls.
Ritual rank IV: advanced rites ask for boss souls.
Ritual rank V: the final rite makes you lord of death. Origin glyphs are yours: other classes only learn them from a Lesson you write.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_necromancer.s: Defeat enemies near the Ossuary Altar or with the Scythe: their souls go to you. Rites ask for specific kinds — the altar shows which.
Every soul has a whisper. Fifty of them are a choir.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_quincy.absorb: The Quincy passive swallows projectiles that hit you; the Absorption form (glyph) pulls in everything nearby and returns it as arrows. Skeletons and mages are great for training.
A skeleton's arrow flies at you and vanishes in a blue glow. Now it's yours.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_quincy.bow.hi: Defeat enemies with Quincy techniques (Spirit Bow and the origin glyphs). For rank I: Circle 1, 20 kills and 15 absorptions; rank up in the Quincy tab (B).
journal.isekai_mahou.class_quincy.bow.lo: The Cross glows and opens into a bow of light. There is no string: only your will.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_quincy.camp.h: The arrow points to the nearest Quincy Camp. Defeat the Quincy until they surrender and perform the Auswählen on them (stay close while the light flows). Quincy players can also accept yours.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_quincy.camp.l: White tents with blue crosses: a Quincy camp. They do not hand over their power for free.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_quincy.intro: Quincy! The Cross from your kit becomes your Spirit Bow. Absorb projectiles, send it all back as arrows, and seek the Quincy camps: the Auswählen is your path to grow.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_quincy.letter: In the Quincy tab (B), choose your Letter (Schrift). Then use the Letter glyph in combat: rank IV asks for 40 uses, 200 absorptions, 4 Auswählen and 2 bosses (Circle 6).
A letter of the ancient alphabet burns in your soul. It says who you are in battle.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_quincy.lore: A Quincy does not create energy: they gather it. From the air, from enemy projectiles, from spells flying their way — all of it becomes arrows on the spirit bow. And there is an ancient rite, the Auswählen, that absorbs the power of surrendered Quincy. Five ranks, one Letter, and at the end the complete form: Vollständig.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_quincy.outro: The wings of light unfold and the whole sky becomes an arsenal. In some distant camp, an old Quincy kneels: the King has returned.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_quincy.rank_1: Circle 1, 20 Quincy kills and 15 absorptions. Rank up in the Quincy tab (B). You learn Absorption, Release and get 8 Silver Tubes.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_quincy.rank_2: Circle 2, 80 Quincy kills, 60 absorptions and 1 Auswählen. You learn Seele Schneider (energy blade), Blut, Silver Tube (glyph) and get the Seele Schneider item.
Spirit Hunter: the Seele Schneider sings.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_quincy.rank_3: Circle 4, 200 kills, 2 Auswählen and 1 boss. You learn Rain of Light and the right to choose your Letter (a modest power of your own).
journal.isekai_mahou.class_quincy.rank_4: Circle 6, 200 absorptions, 4 Auswählen, 40 Letter uses and 2 bosses. You get a Quincy Legend scroll.
Star Knight: the storm of light.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_quincy.rank_5: Circle 8, 600 Quincy kills, 6 Auswählen and 4 bosses. You learn the G form Vollständig and the second Legend. Origin glyphs are yours: other classes only learn them from a Lesson you write.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_quincy.reishi: Quincy open the Reishi Bridge (shortcut glyph) to the Hollow World. Hollows and Menos give plenty of absorption — and the palace bosses count for your ranks.
Quincy have hunted Hollows for generations. The bridge of particles leads straight to their desert.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_quincy.title: The Auswählen
journal.isekai_mahou.class_ranger.arrows: Defeat enemies with the Ranger's Bow or the arrow forms. In the Grimoire, combine the Arrow with effects (explosion, chain, mark...) — it all combines with your elements.
The Explosive Arrow from your kit is just one idea. Build your own.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_ranger.intro: Ranger! The bow from your kit, arrows built in the Grimoire and companions that evolve. Call the pack, mark your prey and follow the Trail in the Ranger tab.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_ranger.lore: A Ranger never hunts alone: the eagle marks the target, the wolf brings it down, the steed carries you away. And every arrow is built like a spell — explosive, seeking, chaining, piercing. The Ranger's Trail goes from Scout to Lord of Beasts, and the companions grow with you.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_ranger.mark.h: Mark targets with the Hunter's Mark (the Eagle marks too) and defeat them. For rank II: level 20, 25 long kills (20+ blocks), 20 marked and 40 companion kills.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_ranger.mark.l: The Hunter's Mark glows over the target. The whole pack knows who dies first.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_ranger.outro: A thousand feathers cover the sky. Below, the pack howls your name.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_ranger.pack.h: Use Pack Call (Ranger glyph in your slots) to summon the Wolf and the Eagle. Their kills count. For rank I: level 8, 25 arrow kills and 10 companion kills.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_ranger.pack.l: A whistle and the brush stirs: the wolf arrives before you finish aiming.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_ranger.prey.h: Defeat bosses or huge creatures (150+ health) with the pack. For rank III: level 35, Circle 4, 1500 blocks ridden, 250 arrow kills and 3 great prey.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_ranger.prey.l: Bosses and beasts with 150+ health. Hunting stories start here.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_ranger.rank_1: Level 8, Circle 1, 25 arrow kills and 10 companion kills. Claim it in the Ranger's Trail tab (B). You learn Net Arrow and Seeking.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_ranger.rank_2: Level 20, Circle 2, 25 long kills, 20 marked and 40 companion kills. You learn Chain Arrow, Steed Call and get the Bow II.
Tracker: the Steed answers the call.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_ranger.rank_3: Level 35, Circle 4, 1500 blocks ridden, 250 arrow kills and 3 great prey. You learn Piercing Arrow, Arrow Rain and get the Bow III.
Forest Warden: a rain of arrows.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_ranger.rank_4: Level 55, Circle 6, 200 companion kills, 150 marked and 6 great prey. You learn Quickdraw, the G form Storm of a Thousand Feathers and get the Bow IV.
Beastmaster: the Storm of a Thousand Feathers.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_ranger.rank_5: Level 75, Circle 8, 250 long kills, 12 great prey and 400 companion kills. You get both Ranger Legends. Origin glyphs are yours: other classes only learn them from a Lesson you write.
Lord of Beasts: both Ranger Legends.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_ranger.ride.h: Summon the Steed and travel on it (the distance ridden counts). Mounted, you shoot and cast normally.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_ranger.ride.l: Wind in your face, bow in hand, and the horizon falling behind.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_ranger.title: The Trail
journal.isekai_mahou.class_rogue.backsta: Hit enemies from behind (or distracted, or while you are invisible): damage is ×2.5. Shadow Step teleports you behind the target. For rank I: level 5, 10 thefts and 20 backstabs.
One shadow step, and the enemy learns too late which side you were on.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_rogue.city.hi: Reach 40 thefts with a city on your way. Robbing a resident in front of a guard is a crime: −reputation, and they come to confront you. Talk to them to Persuade, bribe or give the item back.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_rogue.city.lo: Fat merchants, distracted nobles and watchful guards. The city is a Rogue's paradise — and prison.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_rogue.heist.h: Build the G form Phantom Heist (with any effects you like) and use it on groups of enemies. For rank V: 350 thefts, 800 backstabs, 40 spells stolen and 4 bosses pickpocketed.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_rogue.heist.l: A leap from shadow to shadow, pocket to pocket, and you reappear laughing on the other side of the room.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_rogue.heist.t: G form in the G slot
journal.isekai_mahou.class_rogue.intro: Rogue! Your Ledger is in your kit: steal, backstab, drain mana and even spells. Watch out for city guards... or learn to talk them down.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_rogue.lore: Everything in this world has an owner — even spells. The Rogue disagrees. Goblin pockets, a mage's mana, a paladin's blessing, the spell just cast at you: it all fits in the Thief's Ledger, as long as nobody sees. Five ranks, from Cutpurse to King of Thieves.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_rogue.outro: No royal vault is safe, and everyone knows it. But nobody knows your face: the King of Thieves needs no crown.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_rogue.pickpoc: Use Light Hand (Rogue glyph in your slots) on a mob or NPC: it takes an item from their loot or pocket. From behind the chance is higher. Each target has a single pocket.
Everyone carries something. The secret is getting close without the owner noticing.
Level 5, Circle 1, 10 thefts and 20 backstabs. Use the Ledger (or the Rogue tab in B) to rank up. You learn Vital Point and Mana Siphon. Every rank also gives +2% crit.
Cutpurse: the first name in the Ledger is yours.
Level 15, Circle 2, 40 thefts, 80 backstabs, 1000 resource stolen (Siphon) and 15 Vital Points. You learn Spell Theft, Blessing Theft, Stolen Page and get Shadow Fang (dagger II).
Shadow Filcher: even other people's mana is yours.
Level 35, Circle 4, 100 thefts, 200 backstabs, 8 spells and 6 blessings stolen and 1 boss pickpocketed (Light Hand on the boss mid-fight). You learn Knife Fan.
Guild Shadow: other thieves lower their heads.
Level 55, Circle 6, 200 thefts, 400 backstabs, 20 spells stolen, 15 Pages cast and 2 bosses pickpocketed. You learn the G form Phantom Heist and get the Master Thief's Sting (dagger III).
Level 75, Circle 8 and the Ledger deeds. You get both Rogue Legends, the Phantom Blade (dagger IV), the 4th page of the Stolen Grimoire and double pockets. Origin glyphs are yours: other classes only learn them from a Lesson you write.
King of Thieves: two pockets per target, and the whole world as a target.
Spell Theft copies the recipe of whoever just cast at you (mob, boss or player) into the Stolen Grimoire; Stolen Page casts those pages. For rank III: 6 blessings stolen and 1 boss pickpocketed.
The spell an enemy took years to write, you copy in a second.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_rogue.title: The Thief's Ledger
journal.isekai_mahou.class_shinigami.hol: Shinigami open the Senkai Gate (shortcut glyph) to the Hollow World, where Hollows roam under the eternal moon. Bring a party: the palace bosses show no mercy.
Beyond the paper-and-wood gate, the white desert of the Hollow World.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_shinigami.int: Shinigami! Your Zanpakutō has a soul. Meditate (crouch and stand still) to descend into the Inner World, use Kidō and climb the ranks to Shikai — and one day, Bankai.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_shinigami.kid: Kidō are Shinigami glyphs: build Hadō #4 (and the others as you learn them) in the Grimoire, with any effects you like, and use it in combat. Ranks ask for kills, Kidō and meditations.
Hadō to harm, Bakudō to bind. Ancient words that turn into light in your hands.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_shinigami.lor: Your sword has a name — you just haven't heard it yet. Meditating, the Shinigami descends into their own Inner World, where the blade's spirit waits to talk... or to fight. Sealed, Shikai, Bankai: each release is a promise between soul and steel. And Kidō, Hadō and Bakudō, fits whole in the Grimoire.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_shinigami.med: With the Zanpakutō in hand, crouch and stand still: the Shinigami meditates (much stronger spiritual regeneration) and, focused, descends into the Inner World to speak with the sword's spirit.
Silence, slow breathing, the sword on your lap. On the other side of closed eyes, there is a whole world.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_shinigami.nam: Meditate until you reach the Inner World and talk to the sword's spirit (or defeat it, if it demands). Choose the archetype: Weight makes the target heavier with every cut; White Brush erases their spells.
Weight, Blade Petals, Frost, Ancestral Flame or White Brush. The sword already knew; you just had to learn.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_shinigami.out: When you say "Bankai", the air changes weight. The sword's spirit smiles deep in your soul: the two of you finally speak the same language.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_shinigami.ran: Complete the rank I deeds (Zanpakutō kills, Kidō and meditation) and rank up from the Shinigami tab in menu B. Each rank makes Shinigami techniques stronger (+4% per rank).
The sealed blade answers your call.
More kills, Kidō and meditations. At rank II the Inner World truly opens: there you hear the sword's name and choose your Shikai archetype.
The sword's spirit agrees to talk.
Complete the rank III deeds. Your archetype's Shikai becomes an origin glyph: build it in the Grimoire with stages and elements, like any spell.
Shikai: speak the command and the blade changes shape.
Many Shikai cuts, releases and bosses defeated. Return to the Inner World when the tab says you are ready.
The sword asks for the final trial.
The rank V deeds. Your archetype's Bankai becomes your strongest form — build it in the G slot. Origin glyphs are yours: other classes only learn them from a Lesson you write.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_shinigami.rel: Use the Shikai release in combat (Shikai cuts count for the next ranks). Senkaimon: Shinigami have a shortcut to the Hollow World.
The name spoken aloud, the blade dissolves and is reborn. The battlefield changes owner.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_smith.anvil.h: Place the Arcane Anvil from your kit somewhere safe (your base is great). Click it to open the assembly screen: that is where blades are born and where you rank up.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_smith.anvil.l: The anvil from your kit is no common iron: veins of mana glow in it whenever the hammer falls.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_smith.familie: Forge weapons of different families (dagger, sword, axe, spear, hammer, scythe...). For rank III you also need Circle 4, a Diamond blade, 5 elites defeated with your weapons and 1 boss.
A master has no favorite weapon: only the right weapon for each enemy.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_smith.forge.h: At the Arcane Anvil, pick the family (dagger, sword, axe, spear, hammer, scythe...) and spend forge points on the parts. Confirm with ingots in your inventory. Then reshape it with the forge glyphs (Lengthen, Widen...) with the blade in hand.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_smith.forge.l: Length, width, curve, tip, serration, grip and rune: the weapon is assembled like a spell, piece by piece.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_smith.intro: Smith! Your route is the Arcane Forge: set up the anvil from your kit, forge, reshape and pass the five Forge Trials. I'll mark every step on the tracker, right below the story.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_smith.lore: Between hammer and anvil, the metal listens. A Smith does not buy weapons: they talk to the steel until it is born — the dagger that becomes a sword, the blade that learns runes. Every strike on the anvil is a glyph, and every weapon is a spell with a handle. Five Forge Trials stand between apprentice and Legend Forger.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_smith.masterw: Forge a ★★★★★ blade using every forge point (the Star Steel from rank IV helps a lot). For rank V: a Star Steel blade, Circle 8, 4 different bosses and 600 kills.
Five stars, not a single forge point wasted. A weapon like this earns its own name.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_smith.outro: Star Steel sings at your touch. In the forges of the three kingdoms, the masters take off their aprons as you pass: the Legend Forger has arrived.
Level 5, Circle 1, 1 forged blade, 5 reshapes and 20 kills with a Forged Blade or hammer. Bring 8 iron ingots and click the Arcane Anvil. The tasks are in the Forge tab (B). You learn Widen and Serrate.
Forge Apprentice: the metal already knows your hand.
Level 15, Circle 2, 64 ores, 1 rune, 20 reshapes and 80 kills with your weapons. Anvil offering: 8 iron and 4 gold. You learn Matte, Spark Shower and Conjured Weapon.
Artisan: your weapons are already famous in taverns.
Level 30, Circle 4, 3 families, a Diamond blade, 5 elites, 1 boss and 200 kills. Offering: 4 diamonds. You learn Engrave Rune, Reforge and Blade Field (build them in the Grimoire with your elements!).
Master Smith: the Blade Field answers your call.
Level 50, Circle 6, a Netherite blade, 20 elites, 150 casts of Smith techniques and 2 bosses. Offering: 2 netherite. You learn Arsenal Gate, the G form Star Forge and get 2 Star Steel.
Anvil Grandmaster: the Star Forge lights the sky.
Level 70, Circle 8, a Star Steel blade, a Masterwork, 4 bosses and 600 kills. Offering: 1 Nether Star. You get the tier IV hammer and both Smith Legends. Origin glyphs are yours: other classes only learn them from a Lesson you write.
Legend Forger: your hammer enters history.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_smith.rune.hi: Engrave a rune on a blade at the Arcane Anvil (the Engrave Rune glyph comes at rank III). For rank II you also need to mine 64 ores: a Smith feels every metal vein.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_smith.rune.lo: A rune engraved while hot keeps magic in the steel: the blade remembers the element of whoever forged it.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_smith.title: The Arcane Forge
journal.isekai_mahou.class_steelball.due: With Circle 6 and 5 Parts, the Master offers the lesson IV challenge. Beat him in the duel (he yields when nearly down). Lesson IV also asks for 2 bosses.
"Show me what you've learned." Two balls spin at once, and only one returns to its hand.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_steelball.int: Steel Ball! The ball in your kit spins and comes back to your hand. Master Rotari appears by day when a lesson is ready (or use the Master's Letter), and the Saint's Compass points to the Tombs.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_steelball.lor: A spinning steel ball is not a thrown stone: it is a lesson in geometry. Master Rotari teaches the Spin in five lessons, and nine Parts of the Holy Corpse, hidden in tombs across the world, awaken the spinning nail — Act 1, 2, 3... up to the Infinite Rotation, which nothing can stop.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_steelball.men: Use the Master's Letter from your kit (or wait: he appears by day in the Overworld the first time). Talk to him — he is the one who teaches the five lessons.
A wide-brimmed hat, a crooked smile and two steel balls spinning by themselves in his hand.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_steelball.out: The golden ratio spins on your finger. The Master tips his hat: "There's nothing more I can teach you."
journal.isekai_mahou.class_steelball.par: The arrow points to the nearest Saint's Tomb (the Saint's Compass too). Open the chest and absorb the Part: each one grants a passive power. Rarely, they show up in other chests.
An ancient tomb, a sealed chest and something inside that pulses like a heart.
More Tombs (follow the arrow). For lesson III: Circle 4, 3 Parts, 150 nail hits, 15 spin heals and 1 boss.
Eyes, heart, arms, spine... the Saint is putting itself back together inside you.
For lesson V: Circle 8, 6 Parts, 60 golden hits (Golden Rectangle), 150 mounted kills and 4 bosses. The other Parts are a bonus — and worth it.
Almost whole. The last part whispers from somewhere far away.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_steelball.ran: Circle 1 and 30 hits with the steel ball (throw it with the use button: it comes back). Talk to the Master. You learn Spinning Nail and Healing Spin — Act 1.
Circle 2, 2 Parts, 25 mounted kills and 120 ball hits. You learn Galloping Spin and Muscle Lock — Act 2. Mounted, the ball hits 30% harder.
Circle 4, 3 Parts, 150 nail hits, 15 spin heals and 1 boss. You learn Vortex and Spin Drill — Act 3.
The Spin that Heals and Pierces.
Circle 6, 5 Parts, the Master defeated and 2 bosses. You learn the Golden Rectangle.
The Master's Challenge: the Golden Rectangle.

Circle 8, 6 Parts, 60 golden hits, 150 mounted kills and 4 bosses. You learn the G form Infinite Rotation — Act 4, which nothing can stop. Origin glyphs are yours: other classes only learn them from a Lesson you write.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_warlock.intro: Warlock! Draw the circle with the chalk from your kit around the Offering Altar and call a Patron. Do what it asks — or get ready to fight.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_warlock.kit.h: Place the Offering Altar from your kit and draw the runes around it with the Ritual Chalk. Put the offering on the altar and activate the circle: the Patron appears trapped inside.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_warlock.kit.l: Eight chalk runes, an altar in the center and the silence before the voice.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_warlock.lore: The Warlock draws the circle in chalk, lights the candles and calls someone from the other side. Patrons charge dearly — souls, tasks, oaths — but they pay better. Every pact sealed is a rank; every broken pact, a fight.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_warlock.outro: The patrons now ask YOU for an audience. The chalk circle glows by itself as you pass.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_warlock.pacts: Call different Patrons into the chalk circle and accept their pacts. A freed Patron (refused or failed pact) becomes a mini-boss — defeating it pays too.
One patron is power. Two is a negotiation.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_warlock.patro: Defeat the Imprisoned Patron at the Profane Altar (the story passes there too). Defeated patrons respect the Warlock.
At the Profane Altar, a patron nobody dared to free.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_warlock.rank_: Ritual rank I: talk to the Patron in the circle and accept the pact. Meet its demand in time; refusing or failing frees the Patron to fight.
Ritual rank II: seal more pacts (there are three Patrons: Embers, Void and Drowned).
Ritual rank III: demands grow (souls, bosses, places).
Ritual rank IV: advanced pacts ask for high Circles and rare deeds.
Ritual rank V: the last pact demands everything you are. Origin glyphs are yours: other classes only learn them from a Lesson you write.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_warlock.title: The Pacts
journal.isekai_mahou.class_witch.intro: Witch! The Cauldron from your kit over a fire is your altar. Follow the recipes in the book, brew the ritual potions and collect the five Revelations.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_witch.kit.hin: Place the Cauldron from your kit over fire (campfire or lava). Ritual recipes are on the Recipe Pages; the Ritual Spoon stirs the potion.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_witch.kit.lor: Black iron, green bubbles and a smell that scares off even zombies.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_witch.lore: A Witch does not ask for power: she brews it. Herbs, essences, eyes of things you'd rather not know — in the cauldron, everything becomes a recipe, and every recipe revealed opens a door of her magic.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_witch.outro: The cauldron's steam draws your face in the air. In the three kingdoms, mothers send their children to bed early.
Ritual rank I: brew the ritual potion following a recipe from the book.
Ritual rank II: new recipes ask for creature ingredients and essences.
Ritual rank III: mid recipes ask for a Circle and rare ingredients (swamps and lairs).
Ritual rank IV: advanced recipes use boss parts.
Ritual rank V: the final recipe is the hardest in the book. Origin glyphs are yours: other classes only learn them from a Lesson you write.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_witch.title: The Cauldron
journal.isekai_mahou.class_witch.water_s: Awaken Water and Shadow (elemental shrines or rituals). Together they make the best curses — and their fusion is worth it.
The Witch's two affinities: one heals, one curses.
journal.isekai_mahou.dark_masters.ascens: Reach level 40 (your current Circle's ceiling) and defeat a Dark Master (Lich, Patron, Archmage, Witch or Ent). The Journal hands you the Circle 5 Tribute: just bring it to a ready Ascension Altar (city churches, the Academy or a Sanctum — the arrow points to the nearest).
Power stolen from those who stole power. The altars ask no questions.
journal.isekai_mahou.dark_masters.class_: Advance your class progression to rank III. The Class Route, at the top of the Journal, says exactly what each rank needs (and the tracker shows its next step right below the story).
A master is not made by felling monsters alone. Your class's ritual holds lessons no boss can teach.
journal.isekai_mahou.dark_masters.fifth_: Bring the Circle 5 Tribute to a ready Ascension Altar (city churches, the Academy or a Sanctum — the arrow points to the nearest). Place it on the altar, activate the Ascension Core and defeat your Shadow in the Tribulation. All banked XP comes back afterwards.
Five Circles: halfway there. Your mana no longer fits only inside you — it spills into the world around you.
journal.isekai_mahou.dark_masters.impris: The arrow points to the Profane Altar. It only reaches as far as the chains allow: fight at the edge and avoid the Grip's line of fire. With no chains left it breaks free: save healing for the end.
Four chains bind it to the altar. Each one you break makes it stronger — and closer to you.
journal.isekai_mahou.dark_masters.intro: Feel that chill? A Lich in a forgotten crypt and a chained Patron on a profane altar. They already know who you are...
journal.isekai_mahou.dark_masters.lich.h: The arrow points to the Forgotten Crypt. While the Phylactery exists, the Lich reforms: break the Phylactery (Light hurts it) when the Lich collapses. Break line of sight to cut its drain.
journal.isekai_mahou.dark_masters.lich.l: He died once already. He did not like it and decided not to repeat the experience.
journal.isekai_mahou.dark_masters.lore: Not every power in this world was born clean. In a forgotten crypt, a Lich keeps its own soul in a phylactery and raises the dead as one lights candles. On a profane altar, a chained Patron whispers pacts to anyone who walks by — and every chain that breaks sets it freer. Both have felt your mana grow. And both want a piece of it.
journal.isekai_mahou.dark_masters.outro: The phylactery crumbled to dust and the Patron's chains rusted for good. But as you close the crypt, you hear roars that belong to no known monster: in swamps, deserts, ruins and peaks, the Wild Titans have awakened.
journal.isekai_mahou.dark_masters.title: Masters of Darkness
journal.isekai_mahou.dark_masters.write_: A Lesson (paper, ink and essence) records an origin glyph you know. Whoever reads it learns the glyph if they have the Circle — and you earn XP. Great for trading techniques with friends.
Your class's glyphs are yours alone — unless you decide to teach.
journal.isekai_mahou.elemental_plane.all: The arrow points to the next temple left. Fire, Water, Earth and Wind — one at a time, or with friends.
Whoever defeats all four Guardians is remembered in the songs of the Elemental Plane as "the one from afar".
journal.isekai_mahou.elemental_plane.asc: Reach level 50 (your current Circle's ceiling) and defeat a Guardian (or win Trial V). The Journal hands you the Circle 6 Tribute: just bring it to a ready Ascension Altar (city churches, the Academy or a Sanctum — the arrow points to the nearest).
A Guardian core, still warm, throbs in your hand. The altars know what to do with it.
journal.isekai_mahou.elemental_plane.ent: The arrow points to the Elemental Gate (ruins with 4 obelisks). With the 3rd Circle, activate the dormant portal with the requested offering. Bring blocks: the Plane's islands are far apart.
In a stone circle with four obelisks, a portal of elemental crystals has slept for centuries, waiting for someone to wake it.
journal.isekai_mahou.elemental_plane.fir: In the Elemental Plane, use the Convergence Altar with two Master elements, essences of both and a Mana Crystal Block.
Fire and Earth become Magma; Water and Wind, Ice; Light and Shadow, Twilight. Fusing elements is rewriting the world's rules.
In the Plane, the arrow points to the nearest Guardian Temple you have not beaten yet. Big attacks are marked on the ground before they land: leave the circle! The Bestiary shows their weaknesses.
Ignis in the Ember Isles, Tide in the Suspended Sea, the Primordial Golem in the Earthen Peaks and Zephyr in the Storm Skies.
journal.isekai_mahou.elemental_plane.int: The Elemental Gate has awakened! In the ruins with four obelisks, the path to the Guardians is open. Shall we?
journal.isekai_mahou.elemental_plane.lor: Beyond the sky lies an impossible archipelago: flames burning above a suspended ocean, mountains drifting between eternal storms. There reign the four Elemental Guardians — Ignis, Tide, the Primordial Golem and Zephyr — old enough to remember who sealed the shrines. Prove your worth before them and learn to fuse elements, as only history's greatest mages ever did.
journal.isekai_mahou.elemental_plane.out: The fallen Guardians leave behind cores pulsing with primordial power. With their last breaths, they all tell the same story: Light and Shadow, apart since the Great Rupture, have awakened. And something between them — the Twilight — is hungry. Among the treasures, a golden scroll glows: a Legendary Spell.
journal.isekai_mahou.elemental_plane.six: Bring the Circle 6 Tribute to a ready Ascension Altar (city churches, the Academy or a Sanctum — the arrow points to the nearest). Place it on the altar, activate the Ascension Core and defeat your Shadow in the Tribulation. All banked XP comes back afterwards.
At the Sixth Circle the Domain Expansion is born: a world within the world, where your rules outweigh reality's.
journal.isekai_mahou.elemental_plane.two: Each element's Master node comes from its Trial IV. Win Trial IV with two base elements.
Two elements fully mastered. Only then does fusion stop being a dangerous dream.
journal.isekai_mahou.guild_and_trials.as: Reach level 10 (your current Circle's ceiling) and win Trial I (or the King Slime). The Journal hands you the Circle 2 Tribute: just bring it to a ready Ascension Altar (city churches, the Academy or a Sanctum — the arrow points to the nearest).
The first Ascension is the scariest: the soul breaks so it can grow. Nobody should face it without a tribute.
journal.isekai_mahou.guild_and_trials.di: Touch a Waystone (cities, Guild villages, shrines, lairs and portals have one) to discover it. Use it to travel to the ones you found, or travel from anywhere through the Travel tab (B).
Ancient stones with a rune that glows at your touch. Whoever touched one can return to it in the blink of an eye — paid in mana, of course.
journal.isekai_mahou.guild_and_trials.el: Casting an element's spells and defeating enemies with them gives that element XP. Build spells with that element's effects (9 loadouts: Alt or Mouse 5 + scroll switches). Check the level in the Paths tab.
Each element has its own path. The more you use it, the better it understands you — and the more doors open.
journal.isekai_mahou.guild_and_trials.gu: At the Quest Board (or with the receptionist), accept a quest, fulfil it and return to the Guild to turn it in. Quests give coins, XP and rank points.
Exterminating giant rats is not exactly epic. But it pays, and the Guild never forgets who keeps their word.
journal.isekai_mahou.guild_and_trials.in: Time to become a real adventurer! Let's head to a city: the Guild, a Waystone and the Ascension Altar are all there.
journal.isekai_mahou.guild_and_trials.jo: The arrow points to the nearest city (or Guild village). Talk to the Adventurers' Guild receptionist to get your Card. The Guide Spirit, called from the Journal, flies ahead showing the way.
Every self-respecting summoned hero starts with a rank F adventurer card and a smiling receptionist.
journal.isekai_mahou.guild_and_trials.ki: The King Slime shows up at night in swamps (the arrow points to the nearest). When it leaps, get out of its shadow! Fire works well.
A mountain of jelly wearing a crown. It leaps, crushes and splits into pieces that also want to eat you.
journal.isekai_mahou.guild_and_trials.le: At level 10 you reach the First Circle's limit. Extra XP is banked and comes back after the Ascension — and this chapter's "Ascension" quest hands you the tribute ready to use.
Level 10: the ceiling of the First Circle. Your soul presses against its own edges, wanting more.
Casting and defeating creatures gives XP. In a group, everyone within 24 blocks gets the full kill XP.
Level 5: your mana no longer trembles. The more advanced Arcane glyphs begin to answer your call.
journal.isekai_mahou.guild_and_trials.lo: To the natives, a summoned hero is a walking legend — or walking trouble. The Adventurers' Guild cares for neither: it only wants your name in the register and a job well done. The Trial Chambers are another story. Nobody knows who built them, but every mage who wants to grow in an element eventually crosses their gates, faces waves of creatures and an Elemental Avatar... and comes back stronger.
journal.isekai_mahou.guild_and_trials.ou: With an adventurer card in your pocket and your first Trial won, you hit the ceiling of the First Circle. Your mana asks for more room. Old libraries speak of an Ascension Ritual — and of six shrines that guard the world's essence.
journal.isekai_mahou.guild_and_trials.re: The arrow points to the nearest city. There you will find the Guild, shops, a ready Ascension Altar in the church and a Waystone in the garden.
Walls, bells, markets and a Guild on every square. Three kingdoms share these lands — Aldoria, Sahra and Nordheim — and all of them love a hero who pays for their own drinks.
journal.isekai_mahou.guild_and_trials.tr: Spend 100% of your resource in combat: each time counts as one training (up to 3 per in-game day) and raises the resource Limit, up to your level's ceiling. After hitting zero, regeneration is slow for a minute.
Mana, Vigor or Focus: whoever empties the tank to the last drop comes back with a bigger tank.

Open the Trials tab (B), pick the element and click Start Trial (or /mahou trial start <element>). In the lobby, invite friends and touch the Altar. Beat the waves and the Elemental Avatar. If you fall, nobody loses items.
