The Trial Chamber swallows the daylight. A silent lobby, an altar, and beyond it an arena where your element will test whether you are worthy of it.
journal.isekai_mahou.hidden_horrors.elem: Use an element's spells and techniques and defeat enemies with them. The Paths tab (B) shows each element's level.
Level 12 in an element: the gate to the Master's Trial. The Elemental Plane's Guardians only respect masters.
journal.isekai_mahou.hidden_horrors.fals: The arrow points to the abandoned village. The heads only appear when you are not looking; the song hides the HUD, scrambles your hotbar and heals it. Find the buried body!
The villagers forgot they ever lived there. The Hydra did not forget them.
journal.isekai_mahou.hidden_horrors.intr: This is different: bosses that hide. A Hydra that erases memories, a Manticore in the canyons... Stay close to me and watch where you step.
journal.isekai_mahou.hidden_horrors.lore: There are monsters that roar and monsters that wait. Beneath an abandoned village, the False Hydra sings a song that erases memory — and its heads only exist when nobody looks. In a forgotten vault, the Mimic King turned every chest into a stomach. And in the canyons, the Manticore hunts with a tail of spikes and a roar that freezes courage.
journal.isekai_mahou.hidden_horrors.mant: The arrow points to the Manticore's den. Its tail fans out spikes: stay to the side, not in front. Its roar frightens — keep your distance when it puffs its chest.
A lion's body, bat wings and a tail that fires spikes like a siege crossbow.
journal.isekai_mahou.hidden_horrors.mimi: The arrow points to the Vault. The chests turn into mimics: open nothing before clearing the room. When the king's tongue glows, leave its line: it swallows and spits out players.
A vault full of treasure. Too good to be true — and that is exactly the point.
journal.isekai_mahou.hidden_horrors.outr: The song fell silent and you still remember everything — maybe too much. With the world safer, the path is clear: in the stone ruins with four obelisks, the Elemental Gate has begun to hum.
journal.isekai_mahou.hollow_world.arranc: Elite Arrancar guard the palace road. They use quick steps and beams: fight as a party and save your counter for after their dash.
Hollows who tore off their own masks and gained a human form — and a name, and pride.
journal.isekai_mahou.hollow_world.fey_re: The arrow points to the Fairy Ring. At night, holding a Light Essence, Fey Dust or Moonpetal, use the ring stone: the petal ring opens for 30 s.
Hills in a twilight that never ends, glowing mushrooms and laughter coming from nowhere.
journal.isekai_mahou.hollow_world.gargan: The arrow points to the Garganta Rift. At night, holding a Shadow Essence or Mask Fragment, use the altar: the portal opens for 30 s. Shinigami and Quincy have shortcuts (Senkaimon, Reishi Bridge).
A bone altar in the middle of nowhere. At night, with the right offering, the sky tears like black paper.
journal.isekai_mahou.hollow_world.hollow: Hollows roam the dunes and ruins of the Hollow World. Mask Fragments drop from them (they work as the Garganta's offering). Light hurts them.
Crawlers, Brutes and Wraiths: fast, hungry and always in packs.
Defeat the King of Hueco Mundo

On the palace throne: Barragan. At half health he releases Arrogante and becomes the king of bones — Respira ages and rots: leave the cone, keep away from the purple cloud and don't hug him. He returns a day after being defeated.
Barragan Louisenbairn, God-King of Hueco Mundo and Segunda Espada. A bone crown, an ash axe and the aspect of Old Age.
journal.isekai_mahou.hollow_world.intro: Feel that emptiness in your chest? It's the Garganta calling. A tear in the sky, a white desert, and two rulers in a palace that never sees the sun. Shall we?
journal.isekai_mahou.hollow_world.lore: There is a tear in the sky that only opens at night. Beyond it, a desert of white sand under a moon that never sets, quartz trees and bones the size of towers. There live the Hollows — souls who lost their hearts and wear bone masks instead of faces — and, at the Gate of Las Noches, the two who rule their hunger: Barragan, the King of Hueco Mundo, and the Sand Empress. Before facing the Dragon, the seal asks you to prove you do not fear the void.
Menos Giants appear in the open desert. Get out of the way of the beam it charges in its mouth and aim for the mask. Worth a Menos Core.
A black-robed giant with a long nose, as tall as a tower. It does not walk: it happens.
journal.isekai_mahou.hollow_world.outro: The King of Hueco Mundo falls, and his body of bones turns to dust carried toward the moon. For the first time in ages, the white desert falls silent. In the Rift, something enormous opens an eye.
journal.isekai_mahou.hollow_world.sand_e: At the Gate of Las Noches (center of the Hollow World; the arrow points inside). She sinks and resurfaces: stay away from the whirlpools. The arena is protected during the fight. Bring your party.
The sand obeys her as the tide obeys the moon. Every grain is a blade.
journal.isekai_mahou.hollow_world.thorn_: At the Fey Court, in the center of the realm. Mischievous Fairies and Bramble Hounds protect the Queen: clear them first. The Queen's Wings are the prize.
Beautiful, cruel and surrounded by thorns that dance to the sound of her laughter.
journal.isekai_mahou.hollow_world.title: The Hollow World
journal.isekai_mahou.light_and_shadow.ab: In the Abyss, the arrow points to the Abyss Throne. Light is your best weapon down there; watch the marks on the ground.
The Sovereign rules the Abyss from a throne made of dead stars.
journal.isekai_mahou.light_and_shadow.as: Reach level 60 (your current Circle's ceiling) and defeat the Sovereign or the Seraph. The Journal hands you the Circle 7 Tribute: just bring it to a ready Ascension Altar (city churches, the Academy or a Sanctum — the arrow points to the nearest).
Dead starlight or a six-winged feather: either serves as tribute for whoever dared to take it.
journal.isekai_mahou.light_and_shadow.ca: Use the Legendary Scroll from the previous chapter (the spell goes to the Grimoire's Library), put it in a slot of its element and cast it. If a glyph is missing, the Grimoire tells you which: they come from path nodes (Trials). Careful: some spend ALL your mana.
Explosion. Gate of Treasure. Hollow Purple. Spells that became songs — and are now written in your Grimoire.
journal.isekai_mahou.light_and_shadow.do: An element's Domain node comes from its Trial VI (level 19, Circle 6).
"Domain Expansion." Two words that make even bosses take a step back.
journal.isekai_mahou.light_and_shadow.en: The arrow points to the Abyssal Chasm: a deep canyon with the dormant shadow portal at the bottom. With the 6th Circle, activate it by offering a Shadow Essence. Bring light — lots of it.
In the Abyssal Depths darkness has weight, and the eyes watching from the Void never blink.
The arrow points to the Celestial Stairway, a mountaintop temple holding the Celestial Beacon. With the 6th Circle, activate it at noon with a Light Essence to climb the Stairway of Light.
Crystal cities over cloud gardens, guarded by angels who do not tolerate intruders.
journal.isekai_mahou.light_and_shadow.in: A bottomless canyon and a temple above the clouds: the Abyss and the Celestial Sanctuary await you.
journal.isekai_mahou.light_and_shadow.lo: Below the world, the Abyss throbs like a black heart, ruled by the Sovereign who devours stars. Above the clouds, the Celestial Sanctuary shines with crystal cities, watched by the six-winged Seraph. Both believe you are the key to ending the war that divides them. With a Legendary Spell in hand and the Sixth Circle in sight, both worlds will open their gates.
journal.isekai_mahou.light_and_shadow.ou: The Sovereign and the Seraph have fallen, and with them the balance that kept the Twilight asleep. A rift opens on the horizon, bleeding violet light. For the first time, the Guide Spirit seems afraid: "This is what you were summoned for."
journal.isekai_mahou.light_and_shadow.se: In the Sanctuary, the arrow points to the Celestial Cathedral. Shadow wounds what Light protects.
Six wings, a thousand eyes and an absolute conviction that order is worth more than freedom.

Bring the Circle 7 Tribute to a ready Ascension Altar (city churches, the Academy or a Sanctum — the arrow points to the nearest). Place it on the altar, activate the Ascension Core and defeat your Shadow in the Tribulation. All banked XP comes back afterwards.
Seven Circles. The natives no longer call you summoned: they call you "Lord" and bow their heads.
journal.isekai_mahou.light_and_shadow.tr: Raise an element to level 15 (Circle 4) and start Trial V in the Trials tab (B). Five waves and a Guardian: go as a group if you can.
In the Cataclysm Trial, what waits in the arena is not an Avatar: it is the element's Guardian itself.
journal.isekai_mahou.monster_lords.ascen: Reach level 30 (your current Circle's ceiling) and defeat the Orc Lord or the Minotaur. The Journal hands you the Circle 4 Tribute: just bring it to a ready Ascension Altar (city churches, the Academy or a Sanctum — the arrow points to the nearest).
A Minotaur horn or an Orc Lord's tusk: trophies that become mana in the right hands.
journal.isekai_mahou.monster_lords.corru: The arrow points to the Druid Circle. Fire hurts him badly, and on dirt and grass he regenerates: lure him off the grass. When the ground shakes, jump — roots are coming.
He protected the Druid Circle for a thousand years. Now rot speaks through his mouth.
journal.isekai_mahou.monster_lords.fourt: Bring the Circle 4 Tribute to a ready Ascension Altar (city churches, the Academy or a Sanctum — the arrow points to the nearest). Place it on the altar, activate the Ascension Core and defeat your Shadow in the Tribulation. All banked XP comes back afterwards.
At the Fourth Circle ultimate spells are born: the G slot now holds your finishing blow.
journal.isekai_mahou.monster_lords.intro: The monster lords are on the move: the Orc Lord on the plains, the Minotaur in the labyrinth. Let's go after them — I'll show you the way!
journal.isekai_mahou.monster_lords.lore: With the Goblin King fallen, the other tribes smelled fear — and decided it was time to show who is in charge. On the plains, the Orc Lord gathers the Horde under an axe the size of a door. In a maze that shifts, the Minotaur counts the steps of whoever enters. And in the ancient forest, an Ent who once guarded the druids rots from within, spreading roots that strangle everything alive.
journal.isekai_mahou.monster_lords.minot: The arrow points to the Minotaur's Labyrinth. When he lowers his horns to charge, sidestep: if he hits a wall, he is stunned. That's your moment!
In the labyrinth you cannot build, break or jump the walls. There is only you, the corridors and his snorting, closer and closer.
journal.isekai_mahou.monster_lords.orc_l: The arrow points to the Orc Camp. He charges with the axe, spins and throws it: when he raises the axe, get out of the way. The Bestiary shows his weaknesses.
They say the Orc Lord has never lost a duel. They also say he has never faced someone from another world.
journal.isekai_mahou.monster_lords.outro: The Orc Lord's axe and the Minotaur's labrys now decorate the Guild's wall. But the Fourth Circle brought something else: on moonless nights you feel gazes from crypts, towers and profane altars. The dark masters can count too.
journal.isekai_mahou.monster_lords.title: Lords of the Monsters
journal.isekai_mahou.primordial.ascensio: Reach level 100 (your current Circle's ceiling) and defeat the Herald or the Dragon. The Journal hands you the Circle 10 Tribute: just bring it to a ready Ascension Altar (city churches, the Academy or a Sanctum — the arrow points to the nearest).
The Tenth Circle. No mortal has ever broken it; perhaps because no mortal ever defeated a primordial dragon.
journal.isekai_mahou.primordial.epilogue: For an instant you hear the world's heart: six elements beating to the same rhythm, for the first time since the Great Rupture.
The Rift closes. The two moons shine together, and in swamps, deserts and peaks the monsters sleep in peace.
At the Guild, the receptionist updates your card with trembling hands. There is no rank above S... but she writes one anyway.
In the three kingdoms, bards already sing of the outsider who felled bosses, titans, guardians and, at last, the Dragon itself.
From the Dragon's heart remains a warm ember, pulsing in the colors of every element — as if it were still waiting for something.
The Guide Spirit appears, brighter than ever: "You could go home now... but this world is already your home, isn't it?"
Your legend is written. But the Dragon's ember still beats in your chest and pulls downward: beneath the world, the Endless Abyss is waiting for you.
journal.isekai_mahou.primordial.intro: It's him... the Primordial Dragon! Five phases, no quick deaths: statues, chains, drains. Gather your party and save counterspells for the ultimates. This is what you were summoned for!
journal.isekai_mahou.primordial.lore: Before the shrines, before the Guardians, before even the two moons, there was a dragon that was every element at once. The six sages could not kill it: only seal it beyond the Twilight, with the Herald as its jailer. By defeating the Herald you broke the seal. Now the Primordial Dragon is awake — and it remembers everyone who imprisoned it.
journal.isekai_mahou.primordial.outro: The Primordial Dragon falls, and with it the five storms — fire, ice, stone, lightning and twilight — dissolve into a silence the world had never heard.
journal.isekai_mahou.primordial.primordi: Made for up to 6 max-level players. It doesn't kill outright: it petrifies, chains, drains health, mana and level, swaps places and erases loadouts. Its ultimates demand a COUNTERSPELL. It rises when the Herald falls, in the Rift.
Twenty blocks of scales, five storms and a thousand years of rage. This world's final boss — and it does not fight a hero: it fights an army.
journal.isekai_mahou.primordial.tenth_ci: Bring the Circle 10 Tribute to a ready Ascension Altar (city churches, the Academy or a Sanctum — the arrow points to the nearest). Place it on the altar, activate the Ascension Core and defeat your Shadow in the Tribulation. All banked XP comes back afterwards.
Ten Circles. Mana no longer runs through you: you run within it.
journal.isekai_mahou.primordial.title: The Primordial Dragon
journal.isekai_mahou.programmed_magic.co: The arrow points to the Ancient Hut. Dodge the cursed bottles, take down the cats and strike when she lands from her broom or drinks her healing potion.
In the ancient swamp hut, a witch who traded her own soul for a bottomless cauldron.
journal.isekai_mahou.programmed_magic.in: Spells can link to each other like sentences! And in the Mage Tower, a Renegade Archmage does not want you to learn that.
journal.isekai_mahou.programmed_magic.le: Put the "Leap" glyph (unlocked at level 10) at the END of the spell: Projectile + Arcane Damage + Leap. Each jump costs a bit of mana. Try it against a group of monsters!
A bolt that jumps from enemy to enemy until nobody is left — or until your mana runs dry.
The Arcane Path teaches Links by itself: "On Hit" and "On End" at level 5, "On Kill" and "Leap" at level 10. They show up in the Grimoire palette, in the Links group. Glyph Scrolls teach them too.
On Hit, On End, On Kill: three words that stitch one spell into the next.
journal.isekai_mahou.programmed_magic.lo: The shrine's scroll does not describe a spell: it describes a SEQUENCE. A beam that, on hitting, gives birth to a zone of fire. A bolt that jumps from enemy to enemy while there is mana. Link glyphs turn the Grimoire into a book of programs — and whoever masters them fights like an army.
journal.isekai_mahou.programmed_magic.ou: Your spells now think for themselves: they hit, branch, leap. One night a crystal in your pocket starts to hum and points at the sky. Up there, beyond the clouds, islands float over a suspended ocean. The Elemental Plane is calling.
journal.isekai_mahou.programmed_magic.pe: Craft a Runic Pedestal and place a Mana Battery within 8 blocks (sneak + click it to pour in mana). Write a spell onto a Spell Scroll in the Grimoire and click the pedestal with it. Once it casts on its own, the step is done.
A clever mage does not harvest wheat by hand. A Runic Pedestal casts your spell on its own, tirelessly.
journal.isekai_mahou.programmed_magic.pr: Build a "program": Form + Effect + On Hit + another Form + Effect (e.g. Projectile + Arcane Damage + On Hit + Touch + Push). A Link is ALWAYS followed by a Form.
Beam → On Hit → Zone. That simple. The enemy never understands where the second blow came from.
journal.isekai_mahou.programmed_magic.re: The arrow points to the Mage Tower. Break his arcane shield to stagger him; of the copies, only the real one is not slightly see-through.
Expelled from the Academy for "forbidden research", the Renegade Archmage took a whole tower — and his illusions smile just like he does.
journal.isekai_mahou.programmed_magic.tr: Raise an element to level 9 (Circle 2) and start Trial III in the Trials tab (B). Bring friends: each one adds enemies, but the group gets much stronger.
Four waves, furious Elites and an Avatar that already casts programmed spells against you.
journal.isekai_mahou.six_shrines.ascensi: Reach level 20 (your current Circle's ceiling) and defeat the Goblin King (or win Trial II). The Journal hands you the Circle 3 Tribute: just bring it to a ready Ascension Altar (city churches, the Academy or a Sanctum — the arrow points to the nearest).
The Goblin King's crown holds more mana than gold. City sages know how to turn it into a tribute.
journal.isekai_mahou.six_shrines.goblin_: The arrow points to the nearest Goblin Fortress. Take the archers in the towers out first and beware the king's leap: he smashes the ground where he lands.
In the palisade fortress, the Goblin King counts stolen coins, barks orders and swears the crown is his by right.
journal.isekai_mahou.six_shrines.intro: Six shrines guard the world's essence, and the Goblin King is out stealing. Let's deal with both!
journal.isekai_mahou.six_shrines.lore: They say that before the Great Rupture, six sages sealed the essence of the world in six shrines. Today only the worthy pass their trials. Each awakened element joins your glyphs, and each Circle you break makes your soul vaster. But beware: something at the edges of the world watches your ascension with far too much interest.
journal.isekai_mahou.six_shrines.multi_s: In the Grimoire, use glyphs from both your elements in the same spell (e.g. Projectile + one effect of each). The slot sets the main element; each effect hits with its own element.
Fire that freezes. Wind that burns. Ancient mages called it heresy; summoned heroes call it Tuesday.
journal.isekai_mahou.six_shrines.outro: With two elements flowing through your spells and the Third Circle broken, the veil between worlds grows thin for you. On an old scroll found in a shrine, strange glyphs bind one spell to the next, like sentences of a living incantation...
journal.isekai_mahou.six_shrines.second_: Bring the Circle 2 Tribute to a ready Ascension Altar (city churches, the Academy or a Sanctum — the arrow points to the nearest). Place it on the altar, activate the Ascension Core and defeat your Shadow in the Tribulation. All banked XP comes back afterwards.
Every ten levels the soul hits an invisible ceiling. Only the Ascension Ritual breaks it — and it asks a price: facing your own Shadow.
Conquer the shrine of an element you do not have yet (the arrow points to the nearest), or raise your origin's rituals and use Awaken in the Paths tab.
Among the natives, anyone who controls two elements is already called a prodigy.
journal.isekai_mahou.six_shrines.shrine_: The arrow points to the nearest Elemental Shrine you have not conquered yet: Embers (badlands), Sunken (ocean), Ancestral Cavern, Windswept Peak (mountains), Ruined Cathedral and Darkness. Activate the altar and survive.
The shrines are not impressed by titles or stories from another world. Only by courage and mana.
journal.isekai_mahou.six_shrines.third_c: Bring the Circle 3 Tribute to a ready Ascension Altar (city churches, the Academy or a Sanctum — the arrow points to the nearest). Place it on the altar, activate the Ascension Core and defeat your Shadow in the Tribulation. All banked XP comes back afterwards.
The Third Circle is the threshold between apprentices and true mages. It is also the key to the elemental portals.
journal.isekai_mahou.six_shrines.title: The Six Shrines
journal.isekai_mahou.six_shrines.trial_t: Raise an element to level 6 and start Trial II in the Trials tab (B). Watch the ground: the Avatar's attacks are announced by circles that fill up before they explode.
In the second Trial, the waves bring Elites and the Avatar no longer hesitates.
journal.isekai_mahou.tutorial.cast.dexte: Close the menu and hold %s to use the technique in the 1st slot — shot, card, steel ball, arrow... it depends on your class. Techniques spend %s, which comes back with every hit.
journal.isekai_mahou.tutorial.cast.magic: Now close the menu and hold %s to cast the spell in the 1st slot. It spends %s — the bar on the side shows how much is left.
journal.isekai_mahou.tutorial.cast.physi: Close the menu and hold %s to use the technique in the 1st slot — every class has its own ready. Techniques spend %s, which comes back with every hit that lands.
journal.isekai_mahou.tutorial.class_rout: Your class, %s, has a route of its own: ranks, items and secrets only yours. Open the Menu (%s) and click the Journal tab — it's at the top.
journal.isekai_mahou.tutorial.end: Perfect! The tracker shows the story (from boss to boss) and, right below, your class route. If you get lost, call me from the Journal. Your legend begins now!
journal.isekai_mahou.tutorial.grimoire: Open the Menu again and click the Grimoire tab. This is where glyphs become spells: a Form (how it leaves you) + Effects (what it does). You already have a few ready in your slots!
journal.isekai_mahou.tutorial.loadouts: You have 9 loadouts, each with Z, X, C and G. Hold %s (or %s) and turn the mouse wheel to switch — build one for each kind of fight!
journal.isekai_mahou.tutorial.press_b: Great! Now open the Menu with %s. Status, Paths, Journal, Bestiary, Travel... everything you are lives there. Take a look, then close it with Esc.
journal.isekai_mahou.tutorial.press_j: The Journal marks your next objective in a corner of the screen, with an arrow to places. Press %s to show the tracker!
journal.isekai_mahou.tutorial.resume: Good to have you back! Let's finish what we started — it won't take long.
journal.isekai_mahou.tutorial.story1: Ah, you're awake! I am the Guide Spirit. You were torn from your world and summoned to this one — a place where the very air is made of mana.
journal.isekai_mahou.tutorial.story2: Ages ago, a Primordial Dragon that ruled every element was sealed beyond the Twilight. Now the seal is cracking: ancient bosses awaken and forgotten portals pulse again.
journal.isekai_mahou.tutorial.story3: Your class is %s. You are not strong yet — but every boss that falls brings you closer to stopping it. I'll show you the way. First, the basics!
journal.isekai_mahou.twilight.archmage.h: The Archmage node comes from an element's Trial VII (level 24, Circle 8): the Guardian and the Avatar together.
journal.isekai_mahou.twilight.archmage.l: The title no native has reached in centuries. For a summoned one, it may be just the beginning.
journal.isekai_mahou.twilight.ascension_: Reach level 70 (your current Circle's ceiling) and defeat the Sovereign AND the Seraph. The Journal hands you the Circle 8 Tribute: just bring it to a ready Ascension Altar (city churches, the Academy or a Sanctum — the arrow points to the nearest).
Light and Shadow, finally together in the same tribute. The sages say only a summoned one could carry it.

Reach level 80 (your current Circle's ceiling) and win Trial VI (or defeat all 4 Guardians, or the 3 Hidden Horrors). The Journal hands you the Circle 9 Tribute: just bring it to a ready Ascension Altar (city churches, the Academy or a Sanctum — the arrow points to the nearest).
The last tribute before the Rupture. It weighs like a mountain — and glows like the first spell you ever cast.
journal.isekai_mahou.twilight.eighth_cir: Bring the Circle 8 Tribute to a ready Ascension Altar (city churches, the Academy or a Sanctum — the arrow points to the nearest). Place it on the altar, activate the Ascension Core and defeat your Shadow in the Tribulation. All banked XP comes back afterwards.
Eight Circles. The elements no longer obey: they talk to you, and sometimes ask for advice.
journal.isekai_mahou.twilight.enter_rift: The arrow points to the Twilight Rupture, a cracked stone island. With the 9th Circle and the cores of the Sovereign and the Seraph, the Rift opens. Go prepared.
Beyond the Rift time does not pass: there is only eternal twilight and an arena awaiting you.
journal.isekai_mahou.twilight.herald.hin: Bring your best spells, a Legend, a ready Domain and plenty of healing. When it expands its Domain, answer with yours. And don't spend everything: the fight does not end when it falls.
journal.isekai_mahou.twilight.herald.lor: It also expands its own Domain. When the two Domains collide, only one will can prevail.
journal.isekai_mahou.twilight.intro: The Twilight Rupture... everything leads there. Climb the last Circles and face the Herald.
journal.isekai_mahou.twilight.lore: The Twilight Rift is a wound in the fabric of the world, where Light and Shadow blend into something that should not exist. On the other side waits the Twilight Herald — the being who caused the Great Rupture and who, a thousand years ago, summoned the first hero from another world... and devoured them. Now it calls for you. Break the Ninth Circle and end this story.
journal.isekai_mahou.twilight.ninth_circ: Bring the Circle 9 Tribute to a ready Ascension Altar (city churches, the Academy or a Sanctum — the arrow points to the nearest). Place it on the altar, activate the Ascension Core and defeat your Shadow in the Tribulation. All banked XP comes back afterwards.
At the Ninth Circle your mana stops being a river and becomes an ocean. The Rupture begins to answer your presence.
journal.isekai_mahou.twilight.outro: The Twilight Herald shatters into a thousand fragments of light and shadow... but the arena does not calm down. The ground cracks, the violet sky boils, and from inside the Rift something far greater opens its eyes. The Herald was never the end: it was the seal.
journal.isekai_mahou.twilight.title: The Twilight Rupture
journal.isekai_mahou.wild_titans.desert_: The lair is a tomb in the desert. When its eyes glow, look away: its gaze Petrifies. It also burrows and bursts out of the sand.
In the tomb beneath the dunes, statues of adventurers still hold their swords raised.
journal.isekai_mahou.wild_titans.intro: The ground is shaking: four Titans have awakened. You don't need to beat them all — two are enough for us to move on. Pick your path!
journal.isekai_mahou.wild_titans.lore: Four beasts as old as the shrines slept beneath the world, and your ascension woke them. The Swamp Hydra regrows heads faster than they can be cut. The Desert Basilisk turns to stone whoever meets its gaze. The Ruin Colossus is a golem the size of a tower. And the Wyvern King of the Peaks carries lightning in its wings. Nobody expects you to beat them all... but the bards are cheering.
journal.isekai_mahou.wild_titans.outro: The fallen Titans become tavern legends. But a frightened traveler tells another story: in an abandoned village, a song erases the memory of whoever hears it. And nobody remembers seeing what sings.
journal.isekai_mahou.wild_titans.ruin_co: The lair is a ruin on the plains or in a forest. Its punches open real craters: leave the mark on the ground and hit its back after every blow.
A golem built to protect a city that no longer exists. It does not know that yet.
journal.isekai_mahou.wild_titans.swamp_h: The lair is in a swamp. Severed heads grow back: burn the stump with Fire to stop it. Her poison stacks up — bring milk or healing.
Cut off one head and two grow back. Unless the stump burns.
journal.isekai_mahou.wild_titans.title: Wild Titans
journal.isekai_mahou.wild_titans.trial_f: Raise an element to level 12 (Circle 3) and start Trial IV in the Trials tab (B). It unlocks the element's Master node.
The Master's Trial. Whoever wins it stops being the element's student and starts speaking to it as an equal.
journal.isekai_mahou.wild_titans.two_tit: The arrow points to the nearest lair of a Titan you have not beaten yet: swamp (Hydra), desert (Basilisk), ruins (Colossus) or peaks (Wyvern). Go as a group if you can.
Two primordial beasts fallen by your hand. The world begins to take you seriously.
journal.isekai_mahou.wild_titans.wyvern_: The lair is high in the peaks. It flies and dives: hit it when it lands. If you are Wet you become a lightning rod — stay dry!
It reigns over the peaks and the storms. Lightning falls where it points.
message.isekai_mahou.journal.guide_calle: The Guide Spirit answers your call.
message.isekai_mahou.journal.guide_coold: The Guide Spirit is still gathering itself (%ss).
message.isekai_mahou.journal.hint_comple: Your legend is already complete. Now live it however you wish.
message.isekai_mahou.journal.hint_none: The pages of your destiny are still blank... Call me again later.
message.isekai_mahou.journal.hint_wait: You have done everything this chapter asked. Wait a moment: the story is turning the page.
message.isekai_mahou.journal.legend_broa: ✦ %s defeated the Primordial Dragon and completed the Isekai Journal! A new legend is born in this world.
message.isekai_mahou.journal.open_hint: Open the Journal in the menu (%s). The current objective stays in the corner of the screen (%s shows/hides it).
message.isekai_mahou.journal.spirit_clas: Your class, %s, has a path of its own. I'll mark the steps on the tracker, right below the story.
message.isekai_mahou.journal.spirit_dire: The place is ~%s blocks away — direction: %s. The arrow in the corner of the screen shows the way.
message.isekai_mahou.journal.spirit_else: What you seek lies in another world. Follow the hint to get there first.
message.isekai_mahou.journal.spirit_foll: Follow my trail! The objective is ~%s blocks away — direction: %s.
message.isekai_mahou.journal.spirit_gree: A new chapter begins! Touch me whenever you need a hint — the full chronicle is in the Journal (B).
message.isekai_mahou.journal.spirit_lost: I can't sense that place nearby... Explore farther (about 500 blocks) and call me again.
message.isekai_mahou.journal.steps_more: ✔ ...and %s more quests completed (%s XP in total)
message.isekai_mahou.journal.the_end: — The End of the Isekai Journal —

screen.isekai_mahou.bestiary.no_desc: Little is known about this creature... the Guild's scholars still argue about what it is.
screen.isekai_mahou.journal.call_guide.t: The Guide Spirit appears by your side and, if the objective has a place, flies toward it leaving a trail of light. Click it to hear a hint.
screen.isekai_mahou.journal.empty: The journal is blank... (the chapters have not arrived from the server yet)

journal.isekai_mahou.class_hollowfied.in: You lost to your inner hollow. The mask is yours now — and the hole in your chest craves souls.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_hollowfied.lo: A Shinigami who yields to the inner hollow never returns. Devour souls to evolve: Gillian, Adjuchas, Vasto Lorde... and finally break the mask as an Arrancar and release your Resurrección.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_hollowfied.ou: Arrancar. The mask broken, the power released. The void finally has a shape.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_hollowfied.de: Defeat hostile creatures, hollows or bosses: every kill feeds you.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_hollowfied.gi: Gather souls up to Circle 2 and 120 souls.
Thousands of souls, one giant mask.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_hollowfied.ga: Use the Garganta technique to tear the sky open to Hueco Mundo.
The white desert is your home now.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_hollowfied.va: Small in size, immense in power.
journal.isekai_mahou.class_hollowfied.ar: Become an Arrancar and choose your released form.
Pantera, Murciélago or Serpiente — choose once.
